title: Reverse Linked List
contract: Build a singly linked list from the input values and return its reversed values. Compare copying values with reversing links.
brute: Node head=list(values);List<Integer> copy=new ArrayList<>();for(Node n=head;n!=null;n=n.next)copy.add(n.value);int[] out=new int[copy.size()];for(int i=0;i<out.length;i++){out[i]=copy.get(copy.size()-1-i);emit("Copy from the back","output",out);}return out;
reasoning: A value buffer gives a simple baseline but does not reverse the original nodes.
Before each iteration, previous heads the reversed prefix and head heads the untouched suffix.
Save next before overwriting the link, then advance both pointers. Input/output conversion is excluded from the in-place auxiliary-space comparison.
